mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, u.name AS user_name, ft.name AS from_team_name, tt.name AS to_team_name, cu.name AS created_by_name FROM personnel_transfers p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id LEFT JOIN teams ft ON ft.id = p.from_team_id LEFT JOIN teams tt ON tt.id = p.to_team_id LEFT JOIN users cu ON cu.id = p.created_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO personnel_transfers(user_id, from_team_id, to_team_id, effective_date, transfer_year, applied, applied_at, created_by) VALUES(#{userId}, #{fromTeamId}, #{toTeamId}, #{effectiveDate}, #{transferYear}, #{applied}, CASE WHEN #{applied} THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: WHERE p.transfer_year = #{year} ORDER BY p.effective_date DESC, p.id DESC
WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.effective_date DESC, p.id DESC
WHERE p.user_id = #{userId} AND p.transfer_year = #{year} AND p.applied = TRUE ORDER BY p.effective_date ASC, p.id ASC
WHERE p.applied = FALSE AND p.effective_date <= #{today} ORDER BY p.effective_date ASC, p.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE personnel_transfers SET applied = TRUE, applied_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE personnel_transfers SET effective_date = #{effectiveDate}, transfer_year = #{transferYear}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
